meta.description: Manages and conducts safety programs. Plans, organizes, directs, and controls safety activities. Analyzes mishap causes and trends and assesses risk. Evaluates, inspects, and surveys areas and activities to eliminate mishap potentials. Conducts mishap investigations. Provides risk management consultation. Conducts safety Education.
